color-accent-blue.$description: Brand accent blue: gradient start, icon tile fill, glow source. Not a CTA fill and never text on white.

color-accent-violet.$description: Gradient partner to `color-accent-blue` and the AI marker. Never a fill on its own.

color-accent-sky.$description: On-dark accent only: stat numbers on `color-surface-inverse`. Never on white. Contrast 8.2:1 on `color-surface-inverse`.

color-accent-teal.$description: On-dark accent only: performance stat numbers on `color-surface-inverse`. Never on white. Contrast 8.2:1 on `color-surface-inverse`.

color-action-default.$description: The engine’s primary seed itself (--igd-primary-seed), not a fitted shade. Every action: primary CTA fill (label `color-action-on`), in-page links and eyebrows on `color-surface-page` and `color-surface-tint`. Contrast 5.2:1 on `color-surface-page`, 4.8:1 on `color-surface-tint`, 5.2:1 on `color-surface-page`, 4.8:1 on `color-surface-tint`, 5.2:1 on `color-surface-page`.

color-action-hover.$description: Link hover on light surfaces (colour shift only, no underline). Contrast 5.4:1 on `color-surface-page`.

color-action-fill-hover.$description: Filled-button hover: the primary fill darkens to this and nothing else changes.

color-action-active.$description: Inline link press state on light surfaces. Contrast 8.8:1 on `color-surface-page`.

color-action-text.$description: The action colour when it is text, an icon or a thin line on a light surface: links, eyebrows, outline and ghost button labels, focus outlines. Equal to `color-action-default` by default. A lighter seed is darkened until it reads on `color-surface-page` (AA).

color-action-on.$description: Label and icon colour on `color-action-default` fills. Live value: the engine contrast colour of `igd-primary-600`. Contrast 5.2:1 on `color-action-default`.

color-link-utility.$description: Links in the utility row above the nav, on `color-surface-page`. Contrast 5.4:1 on `color-surface-page`, 5.1:1 on `color-surface-subtle`.

color-link-inverse.$description: Inline links on dark surfaces (`color-surface-inverse`). Contrast 8.2:1 on `color-surface-inverse`.

footer-link.$description: Footer column links on the footer gradient. Contrast 11.1:1 on `igd-dark-surface-200`.

color-focus-default.$description: Keyboard focus outline on light surfaces, `focus-ring-width` at `focus-ring-offset`, `:focus-visible` only. Contrast 5.2:1 on `color-surface-page`.

color-focus-inverse.$description: Keyboard focus outline inside a `data-on-dark` section. Contrast 11.2:1 on `color-surface-inverse`, 11.2:1 on `color-surface-inverse`.

color-text-heading.$description: Headlines h1–h6 on `color-surface-page` and the catalog band. Contrast 17.8:1 on `color-surface-page`.

color-text-primary.$description: Strong text and secondary-button labels on `color-surface-page`; the body default in base styles. Contrast 13.8:1 on `color-surface-page`.

color-text-secondary.$description: Body and lead copy, utility-bar text and nav triggers at rest, on `color-surface-page` and `color-surface-subtle`. Contrast 7.5:1 on `color-surface-page`, 7.2:1 on `color-surface-subtle`, 7.5:1 on `color-surface-page`, 6.7:1 on `color-surface-muted`.

color-text-ui.$description: UI text — nav, buttons, list rows, chips — on `color-surface-page`. Contrast 10.4:1 on `color-surface-page`, 9.9:1 on `color-surface-subtle`.

color-text-muted.$description: Muted copy, nano labels, card descriptions and catalog counts; body copy never goes lighter. Contrast 4.9:1 on `color-surface-page`, 4.7:1 on `color-surface-subtle`, 4.9:1 on `color-surface-page`, 4.9:1 on `color-surface-card`, 4.6:1 on `color-surface-tint`, 4.9:1 on `color-surface-page`.

color-text-inverse-muted.$description: Stat-badge labels and muted copy on `color-surface-inverse`. Contrast 7.2:1 on `color-surface-inverse`.

color-icon-subtle.$description: The caret in the nav row (decorative, below the 3:1 icon floor, kept as in the source). Contrast 2.6:1 on `color-surface-page`.

color-feedback-error-default.$description: Validation text and border on light surfaces. Contrast 7.3:1 on `color-surface-page`, 7.0:1 on `color-surface-subtle`.

color-feedback-error-inverse.$description: Validation text and border on the dark footer. Contrast 5.3:1 on `igd-dark-surface-200`.

color-surface-subtle.$description: Alternating section bands, BrowserFrame title bar, callout strips and chips at rest.

color-surface-tint.$description: Soft blue fill: tinted chips, callouts, the catalog band, release strip at rest and monogram badges.

color-surface-inverse.$description: The one dark treatment: stat badges, table header and dark stat panels (the engine dark-variant surface).

color-surface-tint-strong.$description: Release strip on hover; also the open nav trigger.

footer-background.$description: Footer gradient end; flat fallback for `footer-background-gradient`.

footer-text.$description: Footer body copy, legal links and social glyphs. Contrast 8.6:1 on `igd-dark-surface-200`.

footer-strong.$description: Footer sub-group labels (Web, Desktop, Bundles) and legal-link emphasis. Contrast 14.5:1 on `igd-dark-surface-200`.

footer-heading.$description: Footer 12px uppercase group labels, placeholder and copyright. Contrast 6.2:1 on `igd-dark-surface-200`.

footer-focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring inside the footer.

color-border-default.$description: Hairline border on cards, chips and tinted chips; secondary-button border.

color-border-subtle.$description: Hairline under the nav; default catalog-card border.

color-border-control.$description: Border of a form control (input, checkbox) on light surfaces. 3:1 against the page, the WCAG 1.4.11 minimum. Contrast 4.9:1 on `color-surface-page`.

color-border-accent.$description: Blue-tinted borders: soft blue fills, outline buttons and the release label.

badge-bundle-background.$description: Bundle badge fill (top-right of a ProductCard).

badge-bundle-color.$description: Bundle badge label on `badge-bundle-background`. Contrast 6.6:1 on `badge-bundle-background`.

badge-oss-color.$description: OSS tag label on `badge-oss-background`. Contrast 7.3:1 on `color-surface-page`.

table-mark-yes-color.$description: Comparison table "Yes" mark glyph. Contrast 8.5:1 on `table-mark-yes-background`.

table-mark-partial-color.$description: Comparison table "Partial" and "Gated" mark glyph. Contrast 8.4:1 on `table-mark-partial-background`.

table-mark-no-color.$description: Comparison table "No" mark glyph. Contrast 6.7:1 on `table-mark-no-background`.

table-header-sub-color.$description: Sub-label under a comparison column name, on `color-surface-inverse`. Contrast 7.2:1 on `color-surface-inverse`.

table-header-sub-highlight-color.$description: Sub-label on the highlighted column header (`color-action-default` fill). Contrast 4.8:1 on `color-action-default`.

table-header-detail-color.$description: The "Detail" column header on `color-surface-inverse`. Contrast 12.7:1 on `color-surface-inverse`.

fw-angular-color.$description: Angular framework base colour. The pill fill and border derive from it.

fw-react-color.$description: React framework base colour. The pill fill and border derive from it.

fw-angular-background.$description: Angular framework pill fill; holds on hover.

fw-winforms-background.$description: Windows Forms framework pill fill (shares the Web Components tint).

tile-blue.$description: Icon tile fill — CLI MCP on the AI toolchain row. Flat, never a gradient; white glyph.

tile-violet.$description: Icon tile fill — Agent Skills on the AI toolchain row.

tile-pink.$description: Icon tile fill — Theming MCP on the AI toolchain row.

tile-teal.$description: Icon tile fill — AI Scaffolding on the AI toolchain row.

tile-cyan.$description: Extended icon tile fill for grids longer than four tiles.

tile-amber.$description: Extended icon tile fill for grids longer than four tiles.

tile-royal.$description: Extended icon tile fill for grids longer than four tiles.

tile-ink.$description: Extended icon tile fill for grids longer than four tiles.

color-action-subtle.$description: Tinted capsule fill behind `color-action-default` text. Live: `color-action-default` at `opacity-subtle`.

color-action-subtle-border.$description: Border of the `color-action-subtle` capsule. Live: `color-action-default` at `opacity-strong`.

color-emphasis-border.$description: Border of emphasised cards and the release strip at rest. Live: `color-accent-blue` at `opacity-heavy`.

color-emphasis-ring.$description: Inner ring of the release strip at rest. Live: `color-accent-blue` at `opacity-soft`.

color-emphasis-ring-hover.$description: Inner ring of the release strip on hover. Live: `color-accent-blue` at `opacity-strong`.

nav-background.$description: Sticky nav background, under `nav-backdrop-blur`. Live: `color-surface-page` at `opacity-nav`.

color-overlay-scrim.$description: Page dimmer behind an open nav panel. Live: `color-surface-inverse` at `opacity-strong`.

footer-rule-strong.$description: Footer legal-link dividers and form control borders. Live: `color-text-inverse` at `opacity-muted`.

footer-card-border.$description: Border of the footer newsletter card. Live: `color-text-inverse` at `opacity-subtle`.

footer-field-background.$description: Footer input fill (stacked newsletter). Live: `color-text-inverse` at `opacity-subtle`.

footer-field-pill-background.$description: Footer input fill inside the pill field. Live: `footer-background` at `opacity-field`.

footer-check-background.$description: Footer checkbox fill, unchecked. Live: `color-text-inverse` at `opacity-faint`.

footer-check-border.$description: Footer checkbox border, unchecked. Live: `color-text-inverse` at `opacity-heavy`.

footer-social-hover-background.$description: Social button fill on hover. Live: `color-link-inverse` at `opacity-muted`.

footer-social-hover-border.$description: Social button border on hover. Live: `color-focus-inverse` at `opacity-heavy`.

radius-full.$description: Pills: every action, chip and framework selector. Fully round on controls up to 64px tall; never sharper than 4px. Range 4px to 32px.

nav-panel-radius.$description: Flared top corners of an open nav panel. Range 0px to 30px.

radius-xl.$description: Emphasis and catalog cards. Never a circle: capped at 28px. Range 4px to 28px.

radius-lg.$description: Marketing cards and media frames. Capped at 24px. Range 0px to 24px.

radius-md.$description: Icon tiles, stat badges and nav link rows. Capped at 16px so a tile never becomes a circle. Range 4px to 16px.

radius-sm.$description: Small elements and the monogram badge. Range 2px to 12px.

radius-xs.$description: OSS tag and checkbox. Range 2px to 8px.

focus-ring-offset.$description: Offset of the focus outline; the element itself never moves or changes fill on focus.

size-icon-stroke-strong.$description: `Icon` weight="strong": check marks and close marks on a filled disc.

size-icon-xs.$description: Glyph in a comparison mark; caret in a trigger.

size-icon-sm.$description: Inline arrow in a link or a small control.

size-icon-lg.$description: Nav icon button glyph; comparison mark circle.

size-control-md.$description: Navigation CTA, pill field and its button, compliance seals.

size-control-xl.$description: Minimum accordion row height on mobile.

product-logo-height.$description: Product logo in a catalog card.

stat-badge-offset.$description: How far a floating stat badge overhangs its frame.

stat-badge-inset.$description: Inset of a bottom-anchored stat badge.

field-min-width.$description: Minimum width of a flexible field.

callout-min-width.$description: Minimum width of the copy block in a callout.

callout-max-width.$description: Maximum width of the release strip.

newsletter-min-width.$description: Minimum column width in the newsletter block.

bleed-width.$description: Content width a bleeding frame measures against.

catalog-card-min-width.$description: Min card width in the catalog grid: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(var(--catalog-card-min-width), 1fr)).

letterSpacing.$description: Letter spacing as a multiple of the font size (em).

breakpoint-sm.$description: Two-up copy/media splits stack; footer collapses to accordions; catalog drops to one column.

breakpoint-md.$description: Nav collapses to a menu button; the utility bar hides.

breakpoint-lg.$description: Feature grid goes 3-up → 2-up; the nav items collapse to a menu.

breakpoint-xl.$description: Container reaches full width; the gutter stops growing; secondary nav links hide below it.

opacity-field.$description: Input fill on the dark footer.

z-index-base.$description: Section content sitting above an ambient glow.

z-index-raised.$description: Full-card link overlays; the footer above a card body.

z-index-media.$description: Floating stat badges over a browser frame.

z-index-lift.$description: The G2 card that straddles two bands.

z-index-sticky.$description: Sticky filter bar on the catalog and the nav scrim.

z-index-nav.$description: The site header. Nothing in page content may exceed this.

shadow-raised.$description: Card hover: cards lift shadow only, no translate or scale. Engine elevation 4.

shadow-accent-lg.$description: Primary CTA and its hover (no shadow change on hover). Engine elevation 16 tinted with `color-action-default`.

shadow-accent-sm.$description: Framework pill hover — the only hover change on a pill. Engine elevation 1 tinted with `color-action-default`.

shadow-overlay.$description: Screenshots inside a BrowserFrame. Engine elevation 22.

shadow-accent-md.$description: Bundle cards with the gradient border. Engine elevation 13 tinted with `color-action-default`.

callout-release-shadow.$description: Release strip at rest. Engine elevation 13 tinted with `color-action-default`.

callout-release-shadow-hover.$description: Release strip on hover. Engine elevation 16 tinted with `color-action-default`.

elevation-tint-1.$description: Engine elevation 1, indigo preset, tinted with `action`.

elevation-tint-13.$description: Engine elevation 13, indigo preset, tinted with `action`.

elevation-tint-14.$description: Engine elevation 14, indigo preset, tinted with `action`.

elevation-tint-15.$description: Engine elevation 15, indigo preset, tinted with `action`.

elevation-tint-16.$description: Engine elevation 16, indigo preset, tinted with `action`.

elevation-tint-18.$description: Engine elevation 18, indigo preset, tinted with `action`.

elevation-tint-19.$description: Engine elevation 19, indigo preset, tinted with `action`.

elevation-tint-20.$description: Engine elevation 20, indigo preset, tinted with `action`.

elevation-tint-21.$description: Engine elevation 21, indigo preset, tinted with `action`.

elevation-tint-22.$description: Engine elevation 22, indigo preset, tinted with `action`.

footer-background-gradient.$description: The site footer’s own 155° gradient — one of the two dark surfaces in the system.

gradient-brand.$description: The 92° blue→violet, clipped to one headline fragment per section. Never a background fill, button or tile.

gradient-hero.$description: The hero wash behind the homepage hero.

type-h1.$description: Homepage hero only, in `color-text-heading`. (was `display-h1`; engine slot `h1`)

type-h3.$description: Sub-section and panel heads; `color-text-inverse` on dark. There is no h7. (was `display-h3`; engine slot `h3`)

type-h4.$description: Stat badge values: `color-accent-sky` or `color-accent-teal` on `color-surface-inverse`, `color-text-muted` on light; newsletter title. (was `display-stat`; engine slot `h4`)

type-h6.$description: Product names in a catalog card, in `color-text-heading`. (was `product-name`; engine slot `h6`)

type-h5.$description: Card titles, sentence case, in `color-text-heading` — body face, not the display face. (was `card-title`; engine slot `h5`)

type-subtitle-1.$description: Lead under an h1 or h2, in `color-text-secondary`. (was `body-lead`; engine slot `subtitle-1`)

type-subtitle-2.$description: Hero button label and callout titles. (was `callout-title`; engine slot `subtitle-2`)

type-body-2.$description: Nav, buttons and list rows, in `color-text-ui`. (was `body-ui`; engine slot `body-2`)

type-button.$description: Button and CTA labels. (was `button`; engine slot `button`)

type-caption.$description: Captions, card descriptions and table detail copy. (was `body-caption`; engine slot `caption`)

type-overline.$description: Eyebrows: ALL CAPS, in `color-action-default`. (was `eyebrow`; engine slot `overline`)

type-detail-1.$description: Micro text: utility bar, legal copy, chips. (was `body-micro`; engine slot `detail-1`)

type-detail-2.$description: Badge sublabels and nano meta labels (`color-text-muted`). (was `body-nano`; engine slot `detail-2`)

com.infragistics.css-only.$description: Tokens the format cannot express. They exist in tokens.css and theme.css.
